creative_use: Set one title alone on the frame, as a film or a campaign would: a reveal, a chapter, a name.
limitations: The title is the approved overlay text, up to three lines on a wide frame.
One eyebrow line and one subline at most.
It says one thing; it is not a place for a list.
Validated on one example spec per block at the listed frame sizes, in one palette. Other text, lengths, palettes and sizes are checked when a film is rendered, not by this record.
Frame checks measure background, coverage, edge contact, headline ink and movement. They do not read text or judge design quality.
No audio, no supplied images or footage inside a block, one typeface file, one block per scene.
not_validated: any other text, list length, palette or frame size than the listed inputs
scenes longer or shorter than 3 s
a person's judgement of the design
